definitions.explanation: Something appearing or occurring frequently. Often used in academic and test-preparation contexts for vocabulary, questions, or patterns that come up repeatedly.

examples.japanese: {頻出|ひんしゅつ}⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{頻出|ひんしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This type of question appears frequently on exams.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used as a noun modifier: {頻出|ひんしゅつ}⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧ (frequently appearing vocabulary), {頻出|ひんしゅつ}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (frequently asked questions). Also used as a verbal noun with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Very common in academic and test-preparation contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頻出|ひんしゅつ}⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧ (high-frequency vocabulary)
- {頻出|ひんしゅつ}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (frequently asked questions)
- {頻出|ひんしゅつ}⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ (frequently used expressions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頻繁|ひんぱん}→頻繁：08631_hinpan⟧: frequent — general-use adjective for frequency
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: appears often — colloquial equivalent
